text:
kai: Heads-up 06: the ingestion pipeline flagged a +$12.6k unallocated GPU spend for last 24h, looks like a parsing hit.

ana: link to alert?

kai: https://dash.internal/alerts/ALRT-7221. Raw rows show GCP SKU changed from `nvidia-t4` to `nvidia-t4-eu` in the export, so our tagger didn't match and put into `unattributed`.

billing-bot: Ingestion job billing.ingest_gcp_export v3.9 failed to map SKU for 2026-04-02 00:00-23:59 UTC. Unmapped lines: 4,312.

finance-lead-zach: Ouch. Which customers are impacted? Any external invoices already issued?

kai: Mostly internal teams (playground, infra-dev) but ~3 SMB customers show small deltas (combined ~$1.8k). External invoices for that day haven't closed; monthly invoices go out tomorrow for some SMBs.

cloudops-ryan: GCP release notes mention SKU normalization rolling out in eu-west on April 2. We're seeing the new suffix. We should add a mapping rule in the parser. Quick fix: map `/nvidia-t4(-.*)?/` to T4 canonical.

ana: Can we retro-map the 4,312 lines and re-run attribution? What's the safe path so we don't double-apply credits?

kai: Plan: 1) add mapping to parser (billing-parser repo) -> PR with tests, 2) run dry re-ingest on the affected export (retain original ingest_id), 3) produce delta report and surface to Finance for approval, 4) if approved, reprocess and create adjustment tickets for customers.

vendor-liaison: I'll open a case with GCP to confirm if this is a naming-only change or pricing-impacting. If pricing changed retroactively we'll need vendor credit.

billing-bot: Reminder: reprocessing will update billing.event_id references. Our safety check requires creating a reprocess_manifest and setting `apply_adjustments=false` for dry-run. See ops-playbook/billing-reprocess.md.

finance-lead-zach: Time sensitive. If invoices run tomorrow we'll need Finance sign-off before 08:00 PT. Kai, can you estimate delta per customer?

kai: I ran a quick SQL on raw_export_20260402: ``SELECT customer_id, SUM(cost) as unmapped_cost FROM staging.gcp_raw WHERE sku LIKE '%nvidia-t4%' AND mapped_team IS NULL GROUP BY customer_id;`` Sample output: cust-122: 620.45, cust-77: 915.10, internal-playground: 9,120.02, others small. Total unmapped ~12,650.

ana: Ok. I can review PR and sign off on parser change. Want the dry-run output before any reprocess. Who will run the dry-run and where will the report live?

kai: I'll run dry-run in the billing-sandbox cluster, publish report to /reports/reprocess_20260402_unmapped.csv and post results here. Dry-run should take ~8-12m.

cloudops-ryan: Also going to add a short-term shim in cloud-export lambda to normalize SKU values to the canonical set to avoid another wave while billing-parser PR lands. I can deploy that in 30m.

vendor-liaison: GCP case opened: CRA-99812. Asked them to confirm if sku rename is purely label change. ETA 24-48h.

billing-bot: Note: If we do full reprocess and adjustments, notifications will go to customers who opted-in; accounting will need to approve any invoice version increments.

(15 minutes later)

kai: Dry-run done. Summary CSV uploaded. Top lines: cust-122, +620.45 re-assigned to sandbox; cust-77 +915.10 -> infra-dev; internal-playground +9,120.02 -> playground. Combined customer-facing delta ~1,535.55.

finance-lead-zach: Thanks. Given totals, Finance approves reprocess for internal corrections. For external customers, we should either: A) adjust before invoices (preferred), or B) document and send adjustments after invoice if already sent. We have time to fix before tomorrow, so proceed.

ana: PR merged into billing-parser (PR #512) with mapping rule and unit tests. Build passed.

cloudops-ryan: Export-lambda shim deployed to eu-west export node. Will monitor for repeats; added a metric `export.sku_normalized` and alert if >0 lines normalized.

kai: Starting reprocess with apply_adjustments=true and run_id reproc_20260402_gcp_sku_map. Command: ``./tools/reprocess.sh --ingest-id 2026-04-02-export-01 --manifest reprocess_manifest.json --apply_adjustments true``. Estimated runtime 30m.

billing-bot: Reprocess started (reproc_20260402_gcp_sku_map). Will publish delta report to /reports/reproc_20260402_delta.csv when complete.

vendor-liaison: GCP replied: "sku label changed for region eu-west only; no retroactive price change". Case closed.

(40 minutes later)

kai: Reprocess finished. Delta report: total re-attributed $12,649.67. Customer-facing combined delta $1,535.55. I've created Finance ticket FIN-4972 with the delta report and list of customers affected.

finance-lead-zach: Reviewed FIN-4972. Approved adjustments and invoice version bump. @vendor-liaison, please flag customers with a short note explaining the adjustment and that charges were reallocated due to SKU normalization.

vendor-liaison: Will draft and send notification templates. Also asked GCP for a short note we can share if customers ask.

ana: Closing notes: added parser mapping to canonical set, cloud shim active, reprocess applied, reports attached to FIN-4972. I'll follow up with a short blameless postmortem in #postmortems tomorrow with steps to prevent recurrence.

kai: Thanks team. Setting a watch for 48h. If export.sku_normalized > 0 after 3 runs, we'll escalate to provider eng. :eyes:
